'''Marko''' was a cousin of one of the members of the [[Heroes of Cularin]]. He died in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] at the age of 15, from [[Death stick/Legends|death sticks]].

==Behind the scenes==
Marko had a possible mention in ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'', a scenario in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. In that, following the disappearance of the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], the player characters can roll a dice to find out something relevant to them that happened in the time while they were away and Marko's fate is something that they can get. As whether or not they get this is randomly determined, the information regarding his not definitively [[canon]].
